description: Defines the ImportMapSalesforce class for handling Salesforce import mappings in SuiteCRM, extending ImportMapOther, including configuration for field mappings and ignored fields.

classes.name: ImportMapSalesforce
classes.description: A class extending ImportMapOther, providing Salesforce-specific import mapping configurations.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns default field mappings for specified modules ('Contacts', 'Leads', 'Accounts') with Salesforce-specific fields.

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Returns list of fields to ignore during import, including 'id'.
